sharing.definition: block_sharing_rate = leading block-aligned prefix blocks already present in an earlier request / total block-aligned prompt blocks. This is the infinite-cache ORACLE hit rate and an upper bound on any measured one.

degeneracy_warnings: prompt lengths clipped at min_len=1056 for 10.4% of requests.

notes: OPEN LOOP: precomputed Poisson schedule (bench/loadgen.py discipline); latency is timed from INTENDED dispatch, so harness lateness is included, and a run whose dispatch drift exceeds the threshold is invalid.

slo.source: results/p2/RESULTS.md (job 11608159, H200; TTFT p50 43.4ms x10, TPOT p50 9.3ms x3)

reasons: dispatch_drift: COORDINATED OMISSION RISK (R1): p99 dispatch drift 248.9ms >= threshold 50.0ms. The generator could not issue requests on schedule, so the offered load was not the configured load. Run is INVALID and must not be published.

not_steady_state: Steady state NOT verified: In-flight count TRENDS across the window: this is not steady state. Either the run is above the knee (where steady state cannot exist) or the window is too short. Percentiles from it describe a ramp. Numbers from this window are labeled 'unsaturated-window measurement'.

stationarity.label: unsaturated-window measurement

dispatch_drift.p99_note: n=77: p99 is interpolated near the top of the sample and carries roughly one sample of resolution (R15).

definitions.prefix_hit_rate: delta vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total / delta vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total (TOKEN granularity; preempted requests' re-lookups are not exported, so under preemption this understates reuse)

anomalies.detail: ttft_ms: 2/50 samples > 5x the median (18.4); max 1175.3 at positions [22, 23] in send order. p99 may be set by these alone.
